Rule.name: FSGov-SSOAuthentication
Rule.Description: Rule based SSO for container managed OIDC sign in (JBoss elytron-oidc-client with Microsoft Entra ID). The container has already validated the ID token; this rule maps the authenticated principal (preferred_username, the UPN) to an identity through the email attribute. Returns null when there is no principal or no unique match, which sends the user to the standard login page instead of signing in the wrong person.
